capabilities: Render nested multi-column layouts from %% col-start %% / %% col-break %% / %% col-end %% markers
Edit columns in place with live preview, wikilink autocomplete and image paste
Reorder columns by dragging and resize them by dragging dividers
Style columns, containers and colored headers via tokens and a right-click popover
Generate auto-updating MOCs of note links from folder, tag and property rules
disambiguation: Not a workspace pane-splitting tool; it creates column layouts within a single note's content.
extras: README warns that typing the markers inside a fenced code block breaks reading view and can turn the rest of the note into a code block. States the plugin runs fully offline with no telemetry, and supports the older callout-based ([!col]) layout syntax for legacy notes. Lists other plugins by the author (RSS Dashboard, Media Slider, Zen Space) without describing relationships.
motivation: "The problem with existing multi-column plugin? In Live Preview, when you click into one column to edit it, Obsidian collapses the entire block"
problem: Multi-column layouts built with callouts or code blocks collapse into raw markup in Live Preview when you click into one column, hiding the rest of the layout while editing.
summary: Creates interactive, nested multi-column layouts inside notes using comment markers, so sibling columns stay rendered while editing in Live Preview.
